full_judgment: 5. It appears that it was also urged on behalf of the puffs, at the trial that the transaction between the parties amounted to a complete usufructuary mortgage as provided under Section 95A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, and as such the puffs: were also entitled to redeem the mortgage and recover possession of the land under Section 95 of the said Act. Reference was made to the case of Bangladesh Vs. Haji Abdul Gani Biswas, 32 DLR (AD) 233. The learned Assistant Judge agreed with the submission but refused to grant any relief because in the plaint there was no prayer for redemption of mortgage.
